lina: FYI ran new reranker-candidate-scope change with int8 PTQ on holdout. meta: NDCG@10 +1.9% but MRR@5 -3.7%. short-head slice and exact-match queries tanking.
omar: any change to candidate retrieval or dedupe?
lina: yes  we expanded candidate window from top-50 to top-200 and turned on url-normalize=true in preproc to surface more near-duplicates.
rachel: expanding pool can boost NDCG by giving better tail matches, but MRR suffers if top-1 flips. Did you keep preprocessing parity with offline eval?
lina: offline eval used preproc checksum `c0ffee12`. staging run used `c0ffee12` but with a different tokenizer (byte-bpe-v2 vs bpe-v1). i missed that.
omar: tokenizer diff + quantization = recipe for ordering flips. quant compresses logits so small tokenization-induced score deltas disappear.
lina: repro steps i used: ```
./eval_rerank --gold holdout_v3.json --pred preds_rerank_scope200_int8.json --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@5 --slices head:400,short_exact:220 --tokenizer byte-bpe-v2 --preproc-checksum c0ffee12
```
rachel: can you run a 200-q fast parity test: fp32 vs int8 with identical tokenizer? also try restricting candidates back to top-50 to see effect.
lina: ran quick parity:
- fp32 top-200 byte-bpe-v2: ndcg +2.0 mrr -0.6
- int8 top-200 byte-bpe-v2: ndcg +2.1 mrr -3.5
- int8 top-50 byte-bpe-v2: ndcg +1.1 mrr -0.7
- int8 top-200 bpe-v1 (old tokenizer): ndcg +1.8 mrr -0.5
so the large MRR drop only appears when both candidate expansion and tokenizer mismatch + int8 are present.
omar: sounds like a three-way interaction. mitigations: 1) require tokenizer parity check in onboarding (preproc artifact must include tokenizer id), 2) short-head CI smoke (200 qids) comparing MRR relative to fp32, 3) candidate-window gating: if you expand retrieval window for canary, run an extra sample check.
rachel: also propose adding a tiny deterministic tie-break: add doc_id_hash * 1e-7 to the score before argmax in serving to stabilize quant ties. cheap and often effective.
lina: will open PRs: onboarding preproc schema update (include tokenizer), CI smoke job, and tie-breaker experiment in rerank-serving. uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-eval/artifacts/rerank/scope200/1760012345/ (plots + failing_qids.txt).
eval-bot: snapshot created: rerank-scope200-2026-03-18T08:02:01Z :white_check_mark:
omar: one more ask  annotate model card with "sensitivity: tokenizer + candidate-window under quantized scoring" and land a monitoring dashboard for head-slice MRR.
rachel: +1. also add a note in onboarding checklist to explicitly test candidate-window deltas under the target quant regime.
lina: thanks folks, will queue PRs and tag reviewers. resolving for now with follow-ups.
